name: Labidiosuchus
sum: Labidiosuchus is a notosuchian from the Maastrichtian of Minas Gerais, Brazil, with unusual dentition and a Y-shaped lower jaw.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.

material: One occurrence in the Serra da Galga Formation.
